payload.name: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app.
payload.description: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app. Every app and menu should be working

goal.answer: Build a React-based, desktop-only web recreation of the macOS Tahoe interface, including the transparent menu bar, Dock, window manager, Spotlight, Control Center, and eight core apps as visual/interactive mockups with Liquid Glass styling.

payload.plain: Build a React-based, desktop-only web recreation of the macOS Tahoe interface, including the transparent menu bar, Dock, window manager, Spotlight, Control Center, and eight core apps as visual/interactive mockups with Liquid Glass styling.

criteria.answer:
React project scaffolded and runs with `npm run dev` with no build errors.
macOS Tahoe desktop shell renders: transparent menu bar, Dock, desktop wallpaper, and global context menu.
Liquid Glass visual treatment applied to Dock, windows, sidebars, and menus using CSS backdrop-filter and translucent backgrounds.
Window manager supports open, close, minimize, maximize/restore, drag, resize, and z-index ordering for multiple app windows.
Core apps open from Dock/Spotlight and display a visually faithful, mocked UI: Finder, Safari, Notes, System Settings, Calendar, Photos, Phone, Journal.
Spotlight overlay opens via Cmd+Space or menu-bar click and lists apps plus common actions (visual only).
Control Center dropdown opens from menu bar and shows toggles/sliders for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, brightness, volume, etc. (visual only).
All apps use mock/fake data; no backend or real external integrations required.
Target is desktop (1024px+) with mouse/keyboard interaction; mobile responsiveness is out of scope.

constraints.answer: React single-page app; no backend or external API integrations., Desktop-only target (1024px+), mouse and keyboard driven., Liquid Glass effects implemented with CSS backdrop-filter; no WebGL/Canvas simulation., All app content is mock/fake data; no persistence beyond in-memory React state., No mobile or tablet responsive layout; true macOS window model is preserved., No boot/login sequence; app loads straight into the desktop.

plain: React single-page app; no backend or external API integrations.
Desktop-only target (1024px+), mouse and keyboard driven.
Liquid Glass effects implemented with CSS backdrop-filter; no WebGL/Canvas simulation.
All app content is mock/fake data; no persistence beyond in-memory React state.
No mobile or tablet responsive layout; true macOS window model is preserved.
No boot/login sequence; app loads straight into the desktop.

phases.answer: Scaffold + Design System + Shell, Window Manager, Dock + App Registry, Liquid Glass UI Primitives, Core Apps Batch 1, Core Apps Batch 2, Spotlight + Control Center + Integration

phaseSnapshots.name: Scaffold + Design System + Shell
phaseSnapshots.goal: Create the React/Vite/TypeScript project, set up global design tokens, and render the static desktop shell.
constraints: Context menu is visual only; real actions wired later.

steps.description: Scaffold project with Vite + React + TypeScript and configure Tailwind CSS.

verification.command: npm install && npm run dev starts without errors and serves a blank page at http://localhost:5173/

steps.description: Create global theme tokens (colors, shadows, radii, spacing) matching Tahoe's light/dark palette.

verification.command: grep -r 'tahoe' src/theme/ returns token definitions

steps.description: Build desktop shell components: Wallpaper, MenuBar, Desktop area, and right-click context menu.

verification.command: MenuBar and Wallpaper render visibly in the browser with no console errors

phaseSnapshots.name: Window Manager
phaseSnapshots.goal: Implement draggable, resizable, focus-managed app windows.
constraints: Minimize animates to Dock in a later phase; for now it collapses to taskbar-like state.

steps.description: Create Window component with title bar, close/minimize/maximize buttons, and content slot.

verification.command: A test window renders with title bar buttons visible

steps.description: Add drag and resize interactions with pointer events and bounds checking.

verification.command: User can drag and resize a test window within the viewport

steps.description: Implement window state store (open, minimized, maximized, position, size, z-index focus).

verification.command: Clicking a window brings it to front; z-index updates correctly

phaseSnapshots.name: Dock + App Registry
phaseSnapshots.goal: Build the Tahoe Dock and a registry that maps apps to their icons and window contents.
constraints: Dock uses CSS backdrop-filter Liquid Glass styling.
App icons can be SVG placeholders styled like Tahoe.

steps.description: Create AppRegistry with metadata for the eight core apps plus generic app icon assets.

verification.command: AppRegistry exports an array of eight apps with name, id, icon, and component fields

steps.description: Build Dock component with app icons, hover tooltips, running indicators, and minimized windows area.

verification.command: Dock renders all eight app icons and click opens a window

steps.description: Wire Dock clicks to open/restore windows via the window manager store.

verification.command: Clicking Finder opens a Finder window; clicking again restores focus

phaseSnapshots.name: Liquid Glass UI Primitives
phaseSnapshots.goal: Create reusable Liquid Glass-styled primitives used across apps and overlays.
constraints: No custom shader effects; pure CSS.

steps.description: Implement GlassPanel, GlassButton, GlassSidebar, GlassToolbar, and GlassPopover components with backdrop-filter.

verification.command: Storybook-like demo page shows all primitives with glass effect

steps.description: Add light/dark/tinted variants and a global theme toggle in System Settings scaffold.

verification.command: Toggle switches background theme and glass tint color

steps.description: Add focus/active states and subtle hover transitions.

verification.command: Hover and active states visible on all interactive primitives

phaseSnapshots.name: Core Apps Batch 1
phaseSnapshots.goal: Build visual mockups for Finder, Safari, Notes, and System Settings.
constraints: Apps use Liquid Glass primitives where appropriate.

steps.description: Implement Finder with sidebar, toolbar, path bar, and mocked file grid.

verification.command: Finder window renders sidebar and file icons; folder double-click simulated

steps.description: Implement Safari with address bar, toolbar, tabs, and mocked web page content.

verification.command: Safari window renders address bar and a mocked webpage

steps.description: Implement Notes with note list sidebar and note editor area.

verification.command: Notes window shows list and editor with placeholder text

steps.description: Implement System Settings with settings categories sidebar and detail panes.

verification.command: System Settings window shows categories and a selected pane

phaseSnapshots.name: Core Apps Batch 2
phaseSnapshots.goal: Build visual mockups for Calendar, Photos, Phone, and Journal.

steps.description: Implement Calendar with month grid and event dots.

verification.command: Calendar window renders month view with sample events

steps.description: Implement Photos with grid of placeholder images and single-photo view.

verification.command: Photos window shows image grid and opens a placeholder detail view

steps.description: Implement Phone with Recents, Contacts, and Voicemail tabs.

verification.command: Phone window shows tabs and mocked recents list

steps.description: Implement Journal with entry list and entry editor.

verification.command: Journal window shows entries and an editor area

phaseSnapshots.name: Spotlight + Control Center + Integration
phaseSnapshots.goal: Add global overlays, keyboard shortcuts, and final integration polish.
constraints: Spotlight actions are visual only; no real command execution.
Control Center toggles are visual only.

steps.description: Implement Spotlight overlay with search input, app/action results, and Cmd+Space trigger.

verification.command: Cmd+Space opens Spotlight; typing filters app list

steps.description: Implement Control Center dropdown from menu bar with mocked toggles and sliders.

verification.command: Clicking menu-bar Control Center icon opens the dropdown panel

steps.description: Wire menu-bar app menu to show mocked per-app menus.

verification.command: Clicking an app name in the menu bar shows a dropdown menu

steps.description: Run build, lint, and final visual pass; fix console errors.

verification.command: npm run build exits 0 and npm run lint exits 0

assumptions.answer: Vite + React + TypeScript is acceptable since the user specified React and no stack constraints.; Tailwind CSS is acceptable for styling utility classes.; SVG/PNG icons and static assets are sufficient; no custom icon font generation is needed.; The user will accept a curated set of eight core apps rather than literally every bundled macOS app.; Keyboard shortcuts such as Cmd+Space for Spotlight can use standard browser key handlers without overriding system shortcuts permanently.

charter.intent: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app. Every app and menu should be working
charter.wowFactor: The page feels like sitting at a real macOS Tahoe desktop, with Liquid Glass windows, a smooth Dock, and recognizable app UIs that respond instantly to clicks and keyboard shortcuts.
charter.confirmedScope: A React desktop-only recreation of the macOS Tahoe shell plus eight core apps (Finder, Safari, Notes, System Settings, Calendar, Photos, Phone, Journal) as visual/interactive mockups. Menus and overlays open and look correct but execute no real actions. Mobile/tablet, backend, and real integrations are out of scope.
charter.demoScript: Open the deployed page and see a Tahoe-style desktop with transparent menu bar and glass Dock. Click Dock icons to open draggable windows for Finder, Safari, Notes, etc. Press Cmd+Space to open Spotlight and search apps. Click the menu-bar Control Center icon to open a glass panel with toggles. Resize, drag, minimize, and close windows.

payload.summary: Phase 1 completed after grader feedback: scaffolded React + TypeScript + Vite project with Tailwind CSS v4; created Tahoe theme tokens, ThemeProvider, and CSS variables; built Wallpaper, MenuBar, Desktop, and ContextMenu shell components. Added Vitest + Testing Library with 14 passing tests covering tokens, ThemeProvider dark-class toggle, MenuBar rendering and click handlers, and ContextMenu escape/edge-clamping behavior. Fixed ContextMenu to clamp to viewport using measured size with fallback defaults for jsdom. Verified with npm run build, npm test, and a headless Chrome screenshot showing the desktop shell.

grade.rationale: All phase requirements are met with concrete evidence: `npm test` passes 14 tests (tokens, ThemeProvider dark-class toggle, MenuBar rendering/clicks, ContextMenu escape and viewport clamping), `npm run build` succeeds with a clean Vite production bundle, and the headless screenshot shows the Tahoe-style desktop with a transparent MenuBar and light-to-pink wallpaper. Code is cleanly scaffolded with React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4, theme tokens are comprehensive, and ContextMenu clamps using measured size with sensible jsdom fallbacks.
